first_public_date_basis: First public arXiv submission of the motivating graph-spread paper (arXiv:0902.1156); earlier foundational and complexity sources also cited.
integrity_notes: Universal statements follow from a written Walsh-expansion proof and a classical complexity result; finite exact enumeration is corroborative only. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform measure and unweighted real Lipschitz constraints on a Boolean cube plus common-origin distance-three shortcuts.
Only preservation and an explicit nonsharp loss bound are determined, not the exact below-threshold spread.
The NP-complete decision problem uses a compact cube-plus-triples representation, not an explicit exponentially large adjacency list.
Potential equivalent work in unindexed literature has not been excluded by an independent assessment.
title: Hypercube shortcuts, discrepancy, and the sharp variance-preservation boundary
